<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

# We have 5 selector positions: 15,22,29,36,43
# Top grid has squares at cols 12,22,35,45
# Pink bar has 5 symbols. Selector seems to point to one of the 5 positions in pink bar.
# UP/DOWN actions swap pink bar symbol with top symbol? Let's test UP at each selector position
def get_pink_hashes(frame):
    nodes=frame.segmentation['nodes']
    id_to_node={n['id']:n for n in nodes}
    pink_bar=next((n for n in nodes if n['color']=='P' and any(p[0]>=51 and p[0]<=55 for p in n['boundary'])), None)
    if not pink_bar:
        return []
    return [id_to_node[c]['hash'] for c in pink_bar['children']]
def get_white_col(frame):
    nodes=frame.segmentation['nodes']
    for n in nodes:
        if n['color']=='W':
            b=n['boundary']
            return min(p[1] for p in b)
    return None

# start at col 15
print('start pink', get_pink_hashes(current_frame))
print('white col', get_white_col(current_frame))
# Move to each position and UP
results=[]
for target in [15,22,29,36,43]:
    # move selector to target
    cur=get_white_col(current_frame)
    # compute steps
    steps=target-cur
    if steps>0:
        action(['RIGHT']*steps)
    elif steps<0:
        action(['LEFT']*(-steps))
    col=get_white_col(current_frame)
    pink_before=get_pink_hashes(current_frame)
    action(['UP'])
    pink_after=get_pink_hashes(current_frame)
    results.append((col, pink_before, pink_after))
    # reset selector to 15 for next loop
    cur=get_white_col(current_frame)
    steps=15-cur
    if steps>0:
        action(['RIGHT']*steps)
    elif steps<0:
        action(['LEFT']*(-steps))
for col, before, after in results:
    print('col',col)
    print(' before', before)
    print(' after ', after)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
